query:
UPDATE items
            SET barcode = COALESCE(barcode, $2),
                kcal = COALESCE(kcal, $3),
                prot = COALESCE(prot, $4),
                fat = COALESCE(fat, $5),
                carb = COALESCE(carb, $6),
                piece_g = COALESCE(piece_g, $7)
            WHERE id = $1
